Read the plan: D:\Input Filler\docs\plans\2026-08-03-001-feat-cross-browser-input-filler-plan.md.

Security: This is a client-only extension (no network) with host permission <all_urls> and a content script on all pages. The plan's review already addressed regex ReDoS and chunked storage — verify those are actually implemented correctly rather than re-flagging the concept. If nothing material, say 'No material findings.' Do not edit files. Return a concise numbered list.

validationOutput: Plan's claimed mitigations verified: chunked rules storage and fill-side ReDoS guard/output cap are correctly implemented and tested.
Primary residual security gap: match-side regexes (rules.matchRule, settings.isIgnoredOrigin) bypass isSafeRegex; import path is the realistic entry vector.
residualRisks: Match-side ReDoS (findings #1+#2) remains exploitable until isSafeRegex is applied to match/urlPattern/ignoredDomains and import validation is tightened.
isSafeRegex heuristic is incomplete (finding #3); a vetted safe-regex engine (e.g. re2) would be more robust than expanding the hand-rolled pattern.
password.logToConsole persists generated passwords in the active tab's console when enabled (by design, off by default).
Live browser QA (Chrome/Edge/Firefox SPA behavior) still deferred per plan; this review is static only.
reviewFindings: P2 rules.ts matchRule + settings.ts isIgnoredOrigin: match-side/urlPattern/ignoredDomains regexes run unguarded against page content (DoS via importable unsafe pattern).
P2 rules-ui.ts importRules/isRuleShape: validation too loose (no mode/kind/string/safe-regex checks) — entry vector for #1 and for fill-time throws.
P3 rules.ts isSafeRegex: misses alternation-based evil regexes (e.g. (a|a)+).
P3 orchestrate.ts fillOne: resolveFill unguarded; one bad rule aborts the whole fill pass.
P3 background.ts/content.ts: runtime.onMessage listeners do not validate sender (frame/extension can trigger fills).
P3 orchestrate.ts clearAllForms: unreachable 'option' tag check (dead code).
By-design: password.logToConsole echoes generated password to console; off by default.
childReport.manualNotes: No blockers. The only material security issue is #1+#2 (imported unsafe match-regex → content-script tab freeze on <all_urls>); fix by routing match/urlPattern/ignoredDomains compilation through isSafeRegex and tightening import validation. Everything else is hardening/cleanup.
